pair.name: REDMOND SkyKettle RK-G211S
pair.title: Prepare the kettle
pair.subtitle: Complete four steps before searching
pair.step1: Place the kettle on its powered base.
pair.step2: Hold the On/Off button for about 5 seconds.
pair.step3: Release the button after three short beeps.
pair.note: Pairing mode remains active for 30 seconds.

errors.not_found: Kettle not found. Place it on its powered base and try again.
errors.timeout: The kettle did not answer in time.
errors.no_water: The kettle reported an error. Check that it contains water and is on its base.
